events.name: An Irish Christmas with Rend Collective
events.info: Theres nothing quite like Christmas with Rend Collective. The Northern Irish folk-worship crew brings their signature banjos, foot-stomping singalongs, and living-room warmth to a night of carols and originals youll be humming all the way home. Expect big joy in close quarters the kind of evening where a room full of strangers ends up feeling like family by the last chorus. Bring the whole crew and celebrate the season the Irish way: loud, joyful, and together.TICKET TYPES: Deluxe - Deluxe tickets include earliest entry to choose premium seating, a photo opp with the band, an exclusive Rend journal, and early access to merch shopping. Doors open at 5:15pm, you must arrive by 5:30pm to be guaranteed the Deluxe Experience.Early Entry - Early Entry tickets include early entry into the venue to choose priority seating. Doors open at 6:00pm, you must arrive by 6:15pm to be guaranteed early entry access.General Admission/Family Pack - Doors open at 6:15pm, show starts at 7:00pm. All seating is first come, first served. IMPORTANT INFO: For ADA requests please email ticketsupport@echoconcerts.comAll ticket sales are finalTicket prices are subject to increase at the doorKids 2 and under are free but must sit on a lap and not take a seatAny discounts that become available later are for new, separate purchases and do not apply to previously purchased ticketsTo ensure the safety of our ticket buyers and event attendees, we do not allow third-party ticket sales for any Echo event. Recently, there has been a rise in scams and fraudulent activity related to online ticket sales, we strongly encourage you to buy tickets through the official ticketing platform for any Echo event. The official ticket page can always be found at echoconcerts.com. Tickets purchased from third-party sources or unofficial ticketing websites are not guaranteed by Echo and may limit your access to important event updates or assistance.
